text: Immunology is a core discipline that studies the structure and function of the immune system, aiming to reveal the mechanism by which the body recognizes "self" and "non-self", as well as the role of immune responses in the occurrence, development, and prevention and treatment of diseases. The course is structured around the framework of "basic theory - technical methods - clinical application", aiming to cultivate students' mastery of core knowledge such as immune cell differentiation, immune molecule function, immune tolerance and immunopathology. It enables students to engage in experimental research, technology development or disease diagnosis and treatment in fields such as vaccine research and development, immunotherapy, clinical testing and scientific research institutions, and to become professional talents with immunological thinking
